# winrt-Windows.Perception.Spatial.Surfaces

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `Windows.Perception.Spatial.Surfaces` namespace.

This package provides the `winrt.windows.perception.spatial.surfaces` module.

The WinRT APIs in it are those of version 10.0.28000.2705 of the
`Microsoft.Windows.SDK.CPP` NuGet package.

```

```
